name: Ink Bleed Headline
description: A headline that bleeds onto the page like ink on wet paper: SVG turbulence displacement and blur decay to zero while words fade up in sequence, leaving perfectly crisp type.
a11y: The heading keeps its full text as aria-label; animated words are aria-hidden. Reduced motion: crisp text, no filter.
perf: Filter attributes updated for ~2 s only; filter removed once settled.
prompt: Build an ink-bleed headline: an SVG filter (feTurbulence fractalNoise → feDisplacementMap → feGaussianBlur) applied to the text; on entering view animate a 0→1 progress with Motion's animate(), setting displacement scale (60→0) and blur (6→0) imperatively, while each word fades and rises with a per-word offset. Remove the filter at 1. Replays on re-entry.

name: Magnetic Letters
description: Every letter is a tiny spring: near the cursor letters are pushed away (or pulled in), tilt and gain weight, then spring back with a soft wobble when it leaves.
a11y: aria-label holds the full text; letters are aria-hidden. Off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: One rAF loop for all letters that stops when everything settles; transforms + font-variation only.
prompt: Build magnetic letters: split text into inline-block spans, cache their centres, and on pointermove run a rAF loop where each letter's target offset = direction away from the pointer × (1 − d/radius)² × 28 × strength; integrate a damped spring (stiffness .12, damping .78), rotate by x·0.6°, and raise font weight with influence (variable font). Stop the loop when settled.

name: Liquid Fill Text
description: Outlined letters as glass vessels: two offset waves slosh inside the type (SVG clip to the text) and rise to a level you control — loaders, counters, scroll progress.
a11y: role=img with an aria-label that includes the percentage. Reduced motion: still waves, level jumps.
perf: Pure SVG: two SMIL translate loops and one CSS transform transition.
prompt: Build liquid-fill text in SVG: a clipPath of the text; inside it a group translated by (100 − level) that contains two seamless wave paths (period 50, tile 200) looping horizontally in opposite directions with animateTransform; draw an outlined copy of the text on top. Ease level changes with a CSS transition.

name: Directional Fill Button
description: Hover fill that knows where you came from: a circle grows from the exact entry point and shrinks back toward the exit point. Pure CSS transitions driven by two custom properties.
a11y: Real button; same fill on keyboard focus. Reduced motion: instant colour swap.
perf: Two CSS variables written on enter/leave; transform transition only.
prompt: Build a directional-fill button: on pointerenter/leave write --x/--y (pointer position inside the button); an absolutely positioned 8 px circle at (--x, --y) scales from 0 to 90 on :hover/:focus-visible with a .5 s expo-out transition, behind the label; text colour transitions to the fill-text colour.

name: Particle Dissolve Button
description: On click the button disintegrates: it's sampled into ~600 particles that drift away like sand in the wind (a left-to-right sweep), then a success pill springs in where it stood.
a11y: Success state is role=status; button disabled during the effect. Reduced motion: direct swap to success.
perf: Canvas only exists for ~2 s; particle count capped.
prompt: Build a particle-dissolve button: on click, measure the button, hide it, and draw ~650 particles sampled inside its pill shape on an oversized canvas; each particle starts moving after a delay proportional to its x (sweep), accelerates right and up with jitter and fades. When all are gone, show a success pill with a bouncy spring.

name: Lens Zoom Card
description: Product-photo magnifier: a glass lens springs after the cursor and shows the image magnified underneath, with a refraction rim; scroll over the lens to change zoom; press-and-drag on touch.
a11y: The image keeps its alt; the lens is aria-hidden decoration. Reduced motion: lens follows without spring.
perf: Background-position on one element driven by motion values (no re-render per move).
prompt: Build a lens zoom: a container with an image; a circular element following the pointer through a spring whose background is the same image at zoom× size, positioned so the point under the cursor sits in the lens centre (bg position = −(x·zoom − size/2)). Pop in/out with a spring, wheel adjusts zoom 1.5–5, show the zoom readout.

name: Tear-off Ticket
description: A boarding-pass ticket whose stub you drag down to tear along the perforation: it hinges and rotates as you pull, then drops away with gravity past the threshold.
a11y: A visible “Tear stub” button provides the same action; result announced via aria-live. Reduced motion: stub disappears without the fall.
perf: One draggable element; transforms only.
prompt: Build a tear-off ticket: a top card with perforation notches, a dotted perforation line, and a stub that drags on y with elastic bottom; rotate the stub with y (hinged at the top-left), fade in the perforation gap, and if offset > 110 animate y far down (ease-in) as if falling. Provide a button alternative.

name: Water Caustics
description: Pool-floor caustics in a ~1 KB fragment shader: iterated light focusing in two layers, a deep-to-shallow gradient and a ripple that follows the pointer.
a11y: Decorative canvas behind real content. Reduced motion: one still frame. CSS gradient fallback without WebGL.
perf: Fullscreen triangle, DPR ≤ 1.5, paused off-screen and in background tabs.
prompt: Build a caustics background with raw WebGL: fullscreen triangle; fragment shader computes the classic iterated caustic (5 iterations of trig feedback) at two scales, adds a pointer ripple sin(d·40 − 4t)·e^(−6d) to the UVs, mixes a deep→shallow gradient and adds the light colour. rAF only while visible.

name: Silk Lines
description: Dozens of thin strands flowing like one ribbon of silk: each line is a sum of slow sine waves offset by its index, so the bundle twists, folds and catches light; the pointer bends the fabric.
a11y: Decorative canvas. Reduced motion: still frame.
perf: ~46 strokes per frame with additive blending; paused off-screen.
prompt: Build silk lines on canvas: for each strand k (0..1) draw a polyline across the width where y = centre + sin(u·3.2 + t·.35 + k·2.4)·(0.5 − k)·H·.38 (the twist) + small flow waves + a Gaussian bump toward the pointer; horizontal gradient stroke fading at both ends, alpha peaking in the middle strands, 'lighter' compositing.

name: Smoke Trail Cursor
description: A soft glowing smoke trail: the pointer emits puffs that inherit its velocity, rise, swirl on a noise field, expand and fade; additive blending makes overlaps bloom.
a11y: Decorative and contained to its area; pointer-only. Reduced motion: no trail.
perf: Puffs capped at 420; paused off-screen.
prompt: Build a smoke trail on canvas: on each frame emit puffs along the segment between the last and current pointer positions (more when fast), each with velocity = pointer velocity × .15 plus upward drift; add a swirl from sin/cos of position and time, damp, grow radius, fade life; draw radial gradients with 'lighter' compositing.

name: Context Label Cursor
description: A cursor that reads the room: over elements marked data-cursor="View" (or Drag, Play…) the dot morphs into a pill showing that label in the element's colour; elsewhere it's a small difference-blend dot.
a11y: Native cursor is hidden only on fine pointers inside the area; every target is still a real link/button with its own name. Off on touch.
perf: Spring motion values; label swaps only when the hovered target changes.
prompt: Build a contextual cursor: inside a container hide the native cursor, track the pointer into springy motion values, find the closest [data-cursor] ancestor of the event target and morph a dot (12 px, mix-blend-difference) into a pill sized to the label with data-cursor-color as background; crossfade labels.

name: Zoom Parallax
description: A collage of seven photos pinned in place; as you scroll every tile scales up around the centre at its own rate, so the outer images fly past the edges and the centre photo fills the screen.
a11y: Images are decorative; reduced motion shows a static grid instead.
perf: Seven transforms driven by one scroll progress.
props: Seven images; the first is the centre.
prompt: Build zoom parallax with Motion: a 300vh section with a sticky viewport containing 7 absolutely positioned full-size layers; each layer holds one photo at a fixed % position/size and scales from 1 to its own factor (4–9) with useTransform(scrollYProgress), so the centre image (scale 4) ends full-screen.

name: Scroll Text Mask
description: Giant knockout type as a window: the photo shows only through the letters, then scroll scales the type ~40× from inside a letter until the image fills the screen and the next content fades in.
a11y: The word is available as sr-only text; reduced motion shows the image with the content on top.
perf: One SVG mask scaled with a transform; sheet fades as a fallback.
prompt: Build a scroll text mask: sticky viewport with the photo underneath and an SVG 'sheet' (background-coloured rect masked by a big text knockout) on top; scale the SVG from 1 to 42 around a point inside a letter as scroll progresses 0→.75, also scale the photo 1.35→1, fade the sheet out late as a safety net and fade the follow-up content in.

name: Image Accordion
description: Tall photo panels where the active one expands (flex-grow spring) to tell its story while the others collapse to slim strips with vertical titles. Stacks vertically on phones.
a11y: tablist/tab/tabpanel roles with roving tabindex and arrow keys; mouse hover, focus or tap selects. Reduced motion: instant.
perf: flex-grow and image scale/saturation springs; content mounts only for the active panel.
prompt: Build an image accordion with Motion: a flex row of buttons (tabs); animate flexGrow to 5 for the active one and 1 for others, scale/desaturate inactive images, show vertical titles on collapsed panels and fade/rise the active panel's kicker/title/body after a short delay. Arrow keys move selection.

name: Sortable Grid
description: iOS home-screen reordering in a 2D grid: drag a tile, it lifts and tilts, and the others slide out of the way as you pass over their slots; full keyboard pick-up/move/drop.
a11y: listbox/option roles; Space picks up/drops, arrows move, Esc cancels; every move is announced. Reduced motion: no lift/tilt.
perf: Layout springs only on moved tiles; nearest-slot search on drag.
prompt: Build a sortable grid with Motion: tiles are motion.div with layout and drag (dragSnapToOrigin, no momentum); on drag find the nearest tile centre to the pointer and move the dragged item to that index (layout keeps it under the pointer); whileDrag lifts (scale 1.12, rotate −3°, shadow). Add keyboard pick-up/move/drop with aria-live messages.

name: Circle Reveal Menu
description: Full-screen menu that pours out of the menu button: a clip-path circle expands from the button's centre, huge links rise from behind a mask with stagger, and hovering a link cross-fades its preview image.
a11y: Toggle with aria-expanded; Esc closes and returns focus; links are real anchors. Reduced motion: fade.
perf: clip-path animation on one layer; images mount on hover only.
prompt: Build a circle-reveal menu with Motion: measure the button centre, animate a full-screen nav's clipPath from circle(0% at btn) to circle(150% at btn) with ease [.76,0,.24,1]; link text rises from y:110% inside overflow-hidden lines with stagger; hovering shows that link's image (multiply blend) crossfading; exit reverses.

name: Morphing Tab Bar
description: Mobile tab bar where the active tab grows into a coloured pill that reveals its label: the pill slides (shared layout) and changes colour, the label unfurls, the icon hops.
a11y: Buttons with aria-label and aria-current. Reduced motion: instant.
perf: layoutId pill + width animation on one label.
prompt: Build a morphing tab bar: dark rounded container of buttons with layout; the active button renders a layoutId pill with its own colour and an AnimatePresence label that animates width 0→auto; the icon is keyed by active state so it hops (spring y −6→0) on select.

name: Stacked Sheets
description: iOS-style stacked sheets: each new sheet slides up while the layers beneath scale back, dim and round their corners; drag a sheet down (or Esc) to dismiss and everything springs forward.
a11y: Top sheet is an aria-modal dialog that receives focus; lower layers are aria-hidden; Esc and the grabber button close. Reduced motion: no drag, fades.
perf: Transforms and a brightness filter per layer.
prompt: Build stacked sheets with Motion: the page and each sheet animate scale (1 − .06·above), y (−10·above), rounded corners and brightness based on how many sheets are above them; new sheets enter from y:100%; the top sheet drags on y with elastic bottom and closes past 120 px or a fast flick.

name: Spotlight Product Tour
description: Product tour: a dimmed overlay with a rounded cut-out that glides between targets, a pulse ring, and a tooltip card that flips above/below to stay in view.
a11y: Card is an aria-modal dialog that takes focus each step; arrow keys/Enter step, Esc ends. Reduced motion: no glide or pulse.
perf: SVG mask with one animated rect; measures targets on step and resize.
prompt: Build a spotlight tour: an SVG overlay whose mask has a white full rect and a black rounded rect animated (spring) to the current target's bounds + 8 px; a ring with a ping animation sits on top; a card positioned under or above the target (flip if no room) shows step n/total, copy, dot progress and Skip/Next.

name: Liquid Orb Loader
description: A glass orb filling with liquid: two counter-moving waves rise to the value with a soft ease, bubbles drift up, and the percentage flips contrast as the liquid passes behind it. Indeterminate mode bobs.
a11y: role=progressbar with valuenow (omitted when indeterminate). Reduced motion: still surface.
perf: SVG only: SMIL loops, one CSS transform transition.
prompt: Build a liquid orb loader in SVG: a circle clip containing a group translated to (100 − value) with two seamless wave paths looping in opposite directions (animateTransform), rising bubbles (animate cy/opacity), a glass highlight gradient on top and a mix-blend-difference percentage in the centre.

name: Comet Ring Loader
description: A comet chasing its tail: a conic-gradient ring masked to a thin band whose start angle is an animatable @property, plus a blurred glow copy, gently breathing. Zero JS.
a11y: role=status with label. Reduced motion slows to a calm 4 s turn (loaders must still show activity).
perf: Single @property animation on two elements; no JS.
prompt: Build a comet ring loader in CSS: register --angle with @property, animate it 0→360deg; ring background = conic-gradient(from var(--angle), transparent, tail colour → head colour → white tip), masked with a radial-gradient to a band of `thickness`; add a blurred duplicate for glow and a subtle scale breathe.

name: Slice Transition Slider
description: Editorial slider whose transition cuts the incoming photo into vertical slices that drop in with a staggered, alternating direction; the caption and title rise line by line.
a11y: Carousel region with arrow keys, labelled buttons, aria-live title, autoplay paused on hover/focus and disabled under reduced motion (crossfade).
perf: N slices each with one transform; previous image stays underneath.
prompt: Build a slice slider: render the previous image full-size, then the new image as N flex slices each showing its portion (img width N×100%, left −k×100%); animate odd slices from y:−100% and even from +100% with stagger (ease [.76,0,.24,1]); caption/title lines rise from y:110% after a delay.

name: Scrubbable Area Chart
description: Stock-app area chart: the line draws in when visible, the gradient fill fades up, and scrubbing snaps a crosshair to the nearest point while the headline value rolls and the delta updates.
a11y: The plot is a keyboard slider (arrow keys) with value text; values are real text. Reduced motion: no draw-in or rolling.
perf: Precomputed smooth path; one clip rect animates on scrub.
prompt: Build a scrubbable area chart in SVG + Motion: build a smooth cubic path through the points and an area path; draw the line with pathLength when in view; on pointer move pick the nearest x, clip a bright copy of the line to that x (dimming the rest), show a dashed crosshair and dot, and roll the big number via AnimatePresence.

name: Radial Bar Chart
description: Concentric gauge-shaped radial bars: rings sweep in one after another when visible; hovering or focusing a ring brightens it, dims the others and swaps the centre readout.
a11y: A legend of buttons doubles as the accessible value list and focus target. Reduced motion: static rings.
perf: pathLength per ring; hover only toggles opacity/stroke.
prompt: Build radial bars: for each item an arc from 135° sweeping 270°·value/max (track + value path, round caps), radius decreasing per ring; animate pathLength with a stagger when in view; hovering/focusing a ring (or its legend button) dims the others, thickens it with a glow and shows its value in the centre.

name: Handwritten Signature
description: A signature that writes itself: each stroke draws at a speed proportional to its length, with pen-lift pauses between strokes and a slight ink swell at the end. Starts when visible.
a11y: role=img with a descriptive label. Reduced motion: shown fully drawn.
perf: CSS dash-offset transitions only; lengths measured once.
prompt: Build a self-writing signature: measure each path's getTotalLength, set strokeDasharray/offset to that length, and when in view transition dashoffset to 0 with duration = length/speed and a delay = cumulative previous durations + 0.12 s pen lift; finish with a tiny stroke-width swell.

name: Wave Divider
description: Section divider of stacked ocean waves: each layer is a seamless wave tile drifting at its own speed and direction, back layers paler and slower, giving parallax depth between sections.
a11y: aria-hidden decoration. Reduced motion: static waves.
perf: SVG SMIL translate loops; no JS per frame.
prompt: Build a wave divider: an SVG with preserveAspectRatio=none; each layer is a path made of smooth S-curves with period 1200 spanning 2400 units, filled with its colour, and translated -1200→0 (alternating direction) with animateTransform at a layer-specific duration; last layer matches the next section's background.

name: Shutter Transition
description: Page transition with venetian shutters: blades close top-to-bottom, the page swaps while covered (its name flashes), then blades open bottom-to-top with a stagger.
a11y: Nav buttons have aria-current; content swap is instant for AT. Reduced motion: quick crossfade.
perf: N blades × scaleY; page swapped once under cover.
prompt: Build a shutter transition: on navigate, render N full-width blades that scaleY 0→1 from the top with stagger; when the last closes, swap the page and animate the blades scaleY 1→0 toward the bottom in reverse order; flash the target label on the closed shutter.

name: Zoom Portal Transition
description: Cards that become pages: clicking a card zooms its image (shared layout) to fill the view while the other cards fall back and blur, then the article rises in. Back reverses into the card.
a11y: The page is a focusable article; Esc/Back return focus to the originating card; background cards aria-hidden while open. Reduced motion: instant swap.
perf: layoutId on image and title only.
prompt: Build a zoom portal with Motion: cards with motion.img and title sharing layoutIds with a full-screen article's hero image and heading; open = render the article (AnimatePresence) so the image flies to the hero; the grid behind scales to .92, blurs and dims; content rises after .35 s; Back/Esc reverse.

name: Liquid Metaballs
description: Glossy liquid metaballs (marching cubes) drift on looping paths and merge like lava-lamp wax; an extra blob follows the pointer so you can pull the liquid around. Colours blend where blobs meet.
a11y: Canvas is decorative. Reduced motion: frozen blobs, no pointer blob, still frame.
perf: drei MarchingCubes at resolution 56 (lower on mobile); paused off-screen.
prompt: Build liquid metaballs with React Three Fiber + drei MarchingCubes (enableColors, physical clearcoat material with vertexColors); each MarchingCube moves on a Lissajous path in useFrame; add one more that lerps toward the pointer; light with Environment Lightformers.

name: Hologram
description: Sci-fi hologram: a fresnel-rim shader with scrolling scanlines, flicker and occasional horizontal glitch slices, additive-blended over a projector cone. Knot, head, ring or crystal.
a11y: Canvas is decorative. Reduced motion: no glitch, still frame.
perf: One ShaderMaterial; additive, no depth write.
prompt: Build a hologram in R3F: ShaderMaterial with vertex glitch (random horizontal offset for thin y-bands in brief bursts) and a fragment of fresnel × scanlines (fract(y·22 − t·1.6)) × flicker, additive blending, double-sided; add a ring and an open cone for the projector; slow spin with pointer tilt.

name: AI Image Generation
description: Diffusion-style generation preview: coloured noise resolves to the final image through decaying blur and noise while a scan light sweeps, a step counter and progress ring tick up, and the prompt types out.
a11y: Progress announced via aria-live; final image gets the prompt as alt text. Reduced motion: shows the result immediately.
perf: 64×64 noise canvas scaled up; CSS filters on one image.
prompt: Build an image-generation preview: a square frame with the final image under CSS blur (28 → 0 px), saturation and scale easing with progress; a tiny canvas of random coloured noise (pixelated, overlay blend) fading out; a moving light band; a step counter with a progress ring; typewriter prompt. Drive it with rAF or real progress events.

name: AI Diff Review
description: An agent's proposed edit streaming in: diff lines appear one by one with a cursor, additions flash green and deletions strike through, then each hunk gets Accept / Reject and collapses into a verdict chip.
a11y: Each hunk is a labelled section; status announced via aria-live; real buttons. Reduced motion: all lines shown at once.
perf: One timeout per line while streaming; height collapse on decision.
prompt: Build an AI diff review: stream lines across hunks with a timer; each line enters with a green flash (add) or fade (del with line-through), a block cursor sits on the last line; when a hunk completes show Accept/Reject; on decision collapse the body (height → 0) and show an Accepted/Rejected chip in the header.
